records.label: Use ACES/PIES as the real backbone
records.details: ACES is the fitment/applications layer; PIES is the product/part information layer. Treat retailer catalogs as offer sources, not the data standard.

records.label: Build vehicle reference separately
records.details: Use NHTSA vPIC/recalls and later VCdb-style reference tables for vehicle identity. Do not hard-code vehicle strings inside parts.

records.label: Use public catalogs for examples and links
records.details: RockAuto, NAPA, AutoZone, O'Reilly and Advance can provide public current-offer examples, but full structured feeds require proper access or commercial tools.

records.label: Use commercial fitment platforms for serious catalog scale
records.details: ShowMeTheParts, PDM Automotive, Parts Square and Vertical Development represent the serious ACES/PIES ecosystem.

records.label: Normalize four linked record types
records.details: VehicleFitmentRecord, AutoPartIdentityRecord, AutoPartRetailOffer and Evidence/Warranty/Safety records should be separate and linkable.
